_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Discovery profile UML. Source: metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifCompositeProfile/BasicDiscovery/CDIFDiscoveryProfileSchema.json. The Discovery profile composes Core with five discovery-oriented additions: measurementTechnique, variableMeasured, spatialCoverage, temporalCoverage, hasQualityMeasurement. This config focuses on those additions PLUS the Core classes Dataset and CatalogRecord (re-declared to keep this UML standalone). Core's Dataset/CatalogRecord/Person/Organization/etc. attribute sets are inherited verbatim from CDIFCore in spirit; this config restates Dataset (the discovery extension point) and CatalogRecord (whose conformsTo must be https://w3id.org/cdif/discovery/1.0) and adds the discovery vocabulary. Higher-level composition (Discovery extends Core) is left to the model build process.

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Discovery Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Discovery-oriented metadata extending CDIF Core
targetModel.definition: CDIF Discovery profile - extends CDIF Core with discovery-oriented properties: measurement technique, variables measured, spatial and temporal coverage, quality measurements. Conforms-to identifier: https://w3id.org/cdif/discovery/1.0.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Discovery profile additions on top of CDIF Core.

package.name: Classes
package.definition: Dataset (with discovery additions) and the discovery-specific value classes.

package.name: Coverage
package.definition: Spatial and temporal extent classes: SpatialExtent + AbstractGeometry/GeoCoordinates/GeoShape/Geometry; TemporalExtent + Instant/TimePosition.

package.name: Support
package.definition: Supporting structured types: Identifier, DefinedTerm, Reference (stubs; full definitions in CDIFCore).

class._comment: schema:Dataset, extended with discovery additions (variableMeasured, spatialCoverage, temporalCoverage, measurementTechnique, hasQualityMeasurement). The Core-level attributes are deliberately omitted here; the build pipeline is expected to merge this profile UML with CDIFCore.
class.definition: schema:Dataset extended with Discovery-profile discovery properties. (Core attributes are inherited from CDIFCore at the model-composition step.)

attribute.name: measurementTechnique
attribute.definition: schema:measurementTechnique - technique, technology, or methodology used.

class._comment: schema:variableMeasured payload (used by Discovery). DDI-CDI provenance: InstanceVariable.
class.definition: schema:variableMeasured / cdifVariableMeasured - description of what the dataset measures (e.g. temperature, pressure). In Discovery this is a flat description; in DataStructure it gains role and structural references.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - URI for this variable description.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - variable name (short, machine-friendly).

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - human-readable description of the variable.

attribute.name: propertyId
attribute.definition: schema:propertyID - URI of the property concept (e.g. an ontology term).

attribute.name: unitText
attribute.definition: schema:unitText - unit of measure as text. Maps to DDI-CDI cdi:simpleUnitOfMeasure (string).

attribute.name: unitCode
attribute.definition: schema:unitCode - URI for the unit (e.g. UCUM, QUDT). For full DDI-CDI fidelity prefer cdi:describedUnitOfMeasure (skos:Concept reference).

attribute._comment: Per CDIF profile policy: cdi:describedUnitOfMeasure (originally a DDI-CDI ControlledVocabularyEntry / PairedControlledVocabularyEntry) is implemented here as a skos:Concept reference. The SKOS Concept stub lives in this profile as a target class so the type is locally resolvable; the canonical concept definition lives in the CDIFCodelist profile (see field-level-documentation/CDIFCodelist/Classes/Concept.html).
attribute.name: describedUnitOfMeasure
attribute.definition: DDI-CDI cdi:describedUnitOfMeasure - unit expressed as a reference to a skos:Concept in a controlled vocabulary.

attribute.name: minValue
attribute.definition: schema:minValue - lower value of the measured variable's range.

attribute.name: maxValue
attribute.definition: schema:maxValue - upper value of the measured variable's range.

class._comment: SpatialExtent. No direct DDI-CDI counterpart; plain new. Carries name + identifier and a polymorphic geo end on AbstractGeometry (point, shape).
class.definition: schema:spatialCoverage payload - a schema:Place with name and/or a geo (point or shape) describing the geographic extent of the resource.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - place name.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id / schema:identifier - gazetteer URI.

attribute.name: additionalType
attribute.definition: schema:additionalType - domain-specific type classification(s) for this place.

attribute.name: alternateName
attribute.definition: schema:alternateName - alternate or abbreviated name(s) for this place.

class._comment: AbstractGeometry - abstract supertype of GeoCoordinates and GeoShape (union-type-policy: v1.1 generalization). Lets SpatialExtent.geo target a single end instead of one per concrete geometry kind. The JSON instance carries the concrete schema:GeoCoordinates or schema:GeoShape in @type.
class.definition: Abstract supertype for geographic geometry payloads (point coordinates or named/bounded shape). Concrete subclasses: GeoCoordinates, GeoShape.

attribute.name: crs
attribute.definition: geosparql:crs - coordinate reference system URI (defaults to WGS 84 / EPSG:4326 when omitted).

sssom.object_label: CDIF Discovery AbstractGeometry (polymorphic over schema:GeoCoordinates + schema:GeoShape)
sssom.comment: Introduced as an abstract parent so SpatialExtent.geo can target one end. Concrete subclasses align with schema.org's GeoCoordinates (point) and GeoShape (box / line / polygon).

class._comment: schema:GeoCoordinates - a point geometry (lat/lon and optional elevation). Inherits crs from AbstractGeometry.
class.definition: schema:GeoCoordinates - a single point expressed as latitude + longitude (and optional elevation). Use GeoShape for bounding boxes, polygons, or lines.

attribute.name: latitude
attribute.definition: schema:latitude - decimal degrees, WGS 84 unless overridden by crs.

attribute.name: longitude
attribute.definition: schema:longitude - decimal degrees, WGS 84 unless overridden by crs.

attribute.name: elevation
attribute.definition: schema:elevation - elevation above sea level (metres unless overridden).

class._comment: schema:GeoShape - a non-point geometry: box, polygon, or line. Inherits crs from AbstractGeometry. Concrete shape carried as WKT in geometry OR one of the schema.org native shape attributes.
class.definition: schema:GeoShape - a non-point geometry: box, polygon, or line. May be expressed either as a WKT literal (geometry) or as the schema.org native attributes (box, polygon, line).

attribute.name: geometry
attribute.definition: geosparql:asWKT - well-known-text geometry literal (POINT/LINESTRING/POLYGON/...). Preferred over the schema.org native attributes for non-rectangular shapes.

attribute.name: box
attribute.definition: schema:box - 'minLat minLon maxLat maxLon' bounding box.

attribute.name: polygon
attribute.definition: schema:polygon - polygon as a space-separated list of lat/lon pairs.

attribute.name: line
attribute.definition: schema:line - line as a space-separated list of lat/lon pairs.

class._comment: TemporalExtent represents the schema:temporalCoverage payload, i.e. a time:ProperInterval (or a simple ISO 8601 string). Carries both the simple string form (startDate/endDate/duration) and the OWL-Time structured forms: named-era bounds (intervalStartedBy/intervalFinishedBy) and numeric-age bounds (hasBeginning/hasEnd -> Instant -> TimePosition).
class.definition: schema:temporalCoverage payload - the temporal extent of the resource as a time:ProperInterval (named-era or numeric-age bounds) or a simple ISO 8601 interval string.

attribute.name: startDate
attribute.definition: Start of the temporal coverage (simple ISO 8601 form).

attribute.name: endDate
attribute.definition: End of the temporal coverage (simple ISO 8601 form).

attribute.name: duration
attribute.definition: ISO 8601 duration form (e.g. P1Y) when the coverage is expressed as duration.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - free-text description of the temporal interval.

attribute.name: intervalStartedBy
attribute.definition: time:intervalStartedBy - identifier for a named time ordinal era that is the older bound of the interval (e.g. a geologic age).

attribute.name: intervalFinishedBy
attribute.definition: time:intervalFinishedBy - identifier for a named time ordinal era that is the younger bound of the interval.

class._comment: time:Instant - an instant bounding a ProperInterval (numeric-age form). Carries a TimePosition via inTimePosition. From schemaorgProperties/temporalExtent.
class.definition: time:Instant - a temporal instant used as the beginning or end bound of a TemporalExtent (time:ProperInterval).

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - identifier for this instant.

class._comment: time:TimePosition - a numeric temporal position with a temporal reference system (TRS). From schemaorgProperties/temporalExtent.
class.definition: time:TimePosition - a numeric temporal position expressed against a temporal reference system (e.g. millions of years before present).

attribute.name: hasTRS
attribute.definition: time:hasTRS - identifier for the temporal reference system (default: chronometric geologic time).

attribute.name: numericPosition
attribute.definition: time:numericPosition - the numeric position in the temporal reference system.

class._comment: geosparql Geometry (sf SimpleFeature) - WKT geometry attached to a SpatialExtent via geosparql:hasGeometry, distinct from the schema:geo point/box/line forms (AbstractGeometry). From schemaorgProperties/spatialExtent.
class.definition: geosparql Geometry (OGC Simple Feature) - an exact geometry for the spatial extent, expressed as a WKT literal.

attribute.name: asWKT
attribute.definition: geosparql:asWKT - a WKT geometry literal, e.g. 'POINT(-76 -18)'.

attribute.name: crs
attribute.definition: geosparql:crs - identifier for the coordinate reference system (e.g. CRS84).

class._comment: dqv:QualityMeasurement (DQV). No direct DDI-CDI counterpart at this level (Statistic is closer to actual statistical results than quality assertions).
class.definition: dqv:QualityMeasurement - a single quality measurement reported on the resource (e.g. completeness, accuracy, timeliness) per the W3C Data Quality Vocabulary.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - URI for this measurement.

attribute.name: isMeasurementOf
attribute.definition: dqv:isMeasurementOf - the quality measure being reported, given by name, by @id reference, or as a schema:DefinedTerm (string and @id-reference are JSON shorthands for the DefinedTerm).

attribute.name: value
attribute.definition: dqv:value - the reported result of the quality measure, either as a string or a schema:DefinedTerm from a vocabulary (string is a JSON shorthand for the DefinedTerm).

attribute.name: unit
attribute.definition: Optional unit of measure for the value.

class._comment: skos:Concept stub. Local target class so attributes typed as 'Concept' resolve inside this profile. The canonical SKOS Concept definition (with full alt/hidden labels, scopeNote, history/change notes, etc.) lives in the CDIFCodelist profile; cross-profile HTML links point readers there. DDI-CDI's PairedControlledVocabularyEntry / ControlledVocabularyEntry are implemented across CDIF profiles as references to skos:Concept.
class.definition: skos:Concept (stub). A reference to a controlled-vocabulary term defined in a SKOS ConceptScheme; full definition in CDIFCodelist::Concept.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for this concept.

attribute.name: prefLabel
attribute.definition: skos:prefLabel - preferred lexical label.

attribute.name: inScheme
attribute.definition: skos:inScheme - URI of the owning ConceptScheme.

sssom.comment: CDIF profiles flatten the DDI-CDI scheme+term DataType into a plain skos:Concept reference. The Concept definition itself lives in CDIFCodelist.

class._comment: Identifier (schema:PropertyValue) stub. Local target class so attributes typed as 'Identifier' resolve inside this profile; the canonical definition lives in the CDIFCore profile.
class.definition: schema:PropertyValue / schema:Identifier (stub). A structured identifier with a propertyID (scheme), value, and optional url. Full definition in CDIFCore::Identifier.

attribute.name: propertyId
attribute.definition: schema:propertyID - the identifier scheme (e.g. DOI, Handle, ROR).

attribute.name: value
attribute.definition: schema:value - the identifier value.

attribute.name: url
attribute.definition: schema:url - resolvable form of the identifier.

class._comment: DefinedTerm (schema:DefinedTerm) stub. Local target class so attributes typed as 'DefinedTerm' resolve inside this profile; the canonical definition lives in the CDIFCore profile.
class.definition: schema:DefinedTerm (stub). A controlled-vocabulary term with name, code, and scheme URI. Full definition in CDIFCore::DefinedTerm.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id / schema:identifier - URI for the term.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - the term's preferred label.

attribute.name: termCode
attribute.definition: schema:termCode - code value within the term set.

attribute.name: inDefinedTermSet
attribute.definition: schema:inDefinedTermSet - URI of the controlled vocabulary.

association.definition: schema:variableMeasured - variables described by this dataset.
schema:spatialCoverage - geographic extent of resource content.

association._comment: schema:geo - polymorphic geo end on AbstractGeometry. Replaces flat geometry/box string attributes that previously lived on SpatialExtent. JSON instance carries the concrete schema:GeoCoordinates or schema:GeoShape in @type.
association.definition: schema:geo - the geometry of this spatial extent. AbstractGeometry admits GeoCoordinates (point) or GeoShape (box, polygon, line).
schema:temporalCoverage - temporal extent of resource content.
dqv:hasQualityMeasurement - quality measurements reported on the resource.
geosparql:hasGeometry - an exact (WKT) geometry for this spatial extent.
time:hasBeginning - the beginning instant of the interval (numeric-age form).
time:hasEnd - the end instant of the interval (numeric-age form).
time:inTimePosition - the numeric temporal position of this instant.
